messages:
cheng: Heads-up — I sketched a 'preemptive kernel selector' proposal for FlashAttention v2/v3. Idea: pick v3 for longseq or when KV cache misses are high, otherwise use v2 for shortseq to avoid the ~10% short-seq regression we saw. Need ops + perf sign-off before feature-flag rollout.

maria: the profiling numbers I posted yesterday line up with that. Short summary: v3 latency (p50) on shortseq=32 rises ~9-12% vs v2, but for seq>=512 v3 is ~15-25% faster. Memory: v3 uses ~120MB more for 2048 tokens due to extra buffers.

sam: can we express the selector as a lightweight heuristic? suggestions: sequence_length threshold + kv_hit_rate threshold + hysteresis window to avoid flip-flopping. Something like: if seq_len>256 OR kv_hit_rate<0.8 -> prefer v3; else v2.

leo: note from canary testing: when kv cache is enabled but fragmented (many small prefixes), v3 loses its advantage until cache warms. We should add a sticky window: once we pick v3 for a session, keep it for N requests or M ms.

maria: agreed. I prototyped a hysteresis param and measured thrash: hysteresis=3 requests removed ~95% of mode switches during bursty traffic. Happy to share the script.

cheng: thanks. I put flag names and default values in the draft config below. Please review naming and defaults. If no objections, ops can flip a canary.

sam: looks good. flag names should be explicit for audits. Also add an emergency backstop: if p95 latency jumps > 2x baseline during canary, auto-fallback to v2 for that route.

-- feature_flags snippet --

```
fa_preemptive_attn_selector: on
fa_selector_seq_threshold: 256
fa_selector_kv_hit_threshold: 0.8
fa_selector_hysteresis_requests: 3
fa_selector_sticky_ms: 2000
fa_selector_safemode_p95_multiplier: 2.0
```

leo: Ops notes: staging run with 10k qps spike — the autoscaler handled GPU add/remove but we saw a short OOM on a multi-GPU pod when v3 was chosen and kv cache was enabled. Patch idea: limit v3 to single-GPU pods when kv_enabled=true until we verify memory patterns.

cheng: good catch. I'll add a hard rule in selector: if kv_enabled && pod_gpus>1 && est_mem_delta>threshold -> prefer v2. We need a reliable est_mem_delta estimator; Maria, can your profiler produce that metric?

maria: yes — I can add est_mem_delta per model/profile. It will be coarse but good enough for a selector preference. I'll attach a small table in the canary notes:

Model X | seq32 | seq512 | seq2048
------|------:|-------:|--------:
latency v2 p50 | 12ms | 48ms | 180ms
latency v3 p50 | 13ms | 36ms | 140ms
mem delta (v3-v2) | +10MB | +45MB | +120MB

sam: rollout plan proposal: 1) enable flag globally OFF. 2) enable for small canary (5% routes) with hysteresis=5, sticky_ms=1s, safemode monitor on. 3) run for 48h, watch route-level p50/p95, error rate, GPU mem OOMs. 4) if safe, ramp to 25% then 50% then 100% with progressively relaxed hysteresis.

leo: add a dev schedule for quick rollback: a single CLI cmd to set fa_preemptive_attn_selector=off and queue a forced model selection sync across nodes. Ops knows the command.

ops-bot: canary-deploy triggered by @sam at 2026-03-18T13:02:00Z ; target routes: embedder, chat-shortseq, rerank-slow.

deploy-bot: canary 3923460001 completed: 5% traffic. health: green. p50 changes: +1.2% overall; shortseq chat route p50: +9.8%. safemode monitors armed.

cheng: thanks all. Action items: Maria -> add est_mem_delta profiler output + attach scripts (due EOD). Sam -> create canary runbook and rollback command (tomorrow). Leo -> prepare quick OOM mitigations (limit v3 on multi-gpu pods). I'll update the selector PR with these rules and open the feature flag rollout changelist.

maria: attaching profiler link in #eng-runtime later. I'll also dump the raw flame charts for the shortseq regression.

sam: I'll draft the runbook and include the auto-fallback trigger and metric dashboards to watch.

cheng: great. ping me when PR is ready and we'll schedule the canary window. :thumbsup:
